kind: pre-registration of a practice screen on the server's GPU in the weekend's window: the stack with line heads and its control, three seeds each
why: line_heads.json passed all three readings: with two of every read's four heads counting lines, the stack recalls a binding 150 to 200 bytes back (0.965 and 0.975 against 0.195 and 0.290) and, unpractised, writes 0.785 of 12-hop and 0.455 of 16-hop chains whole (the control 0.205 and 0.015). Its registered consequence is this step: line-stack goes into the practice loop with rehearsal and the cap at 12, three seeds, read at 20 hops against r12-stack and r8-tf of practice_cap_raised.json. Those runs began from other bases on other code and hardware, and two trainings of chain-stack's recipe differ widely in how far they chain unpractised (chain-stack wrote no 8-hop chain whole, cell-stack 0.655). So the control is cell-stack, line-stack's own control, practised the same way beside it; the comparison with r12-stack and r8-tf is reported as registered.

arms.cell-pr-s0, -s1, -s2: from cell-stack, the same flags and seeds
arms.loop: practice_cap_raised.json's loop with the cap at 12: 16 tasks a round at the staircase's place, 8 attempts at temperature 1, reward 1 for the right answer, only attempts above their task's mean teaching (--dips 0, the loop as registered there; practice_that_stands.json tests --dips 1 separately), the written chains of 16 fresh tasks of 1 to 4 hops rehearsed every round, Adam at 3e-5 clipped at 1, 2,000 rounds, room for 64 bytes (a 20-hop chain takes 59).
arms.code: Code copy v18r (452f365), the copy that trained both bases. --exact-products leaves the weights as without it to the bit; neither arm takes --fused-reads, which line heads do not have, so the two arms share their read.

where: The server's GPU 1, the six runs side by side under MPS, after practice_that_stands.json's runs and before the full-size runs queued behind them (fs-loop6-lift-pc3 and the data-slope runs).
measure: Along the way, before the first round and every 100 rounds, 200 tasks of 2, 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20 hops; after the last round experiments/practice_loop.py --families hops --evaluate 1 2 3 4 5 6 8 12 16 20 --evaluate-tasks 200 --max-bytes 64 --seed 0: the accuracy of the last byte and the share of answers that write the whole chain as the corpus writes it, each with its 95% Wilson interval, and the mean bytes. The marks of practice_several_families.json for one family: kept (a mean accuracy of at least 0.95 over 1 to 4 hops after practice), held (at least 0.90 at 2 and at 4 hops at every one of the 20 evaluations along the way), reach (at 8 hops after practice an accuracy of at least 0.50 with at least half the answers writing the whole chain) and reach kept (reach at each of the last five evaluations); a run holds if it meets all four. After practice, the probe of recall_over_distance.json on every run's weights.

reading.(1) line heads practise further: Whole chains at 20 hops after practice, line-pr against cell-pr seed by seed: line heads practise further if line-pr's share is ahead (at least 0.10 higher with the two 95% intervals apart) in at least two of the three seeds and behind in none; cell-pr practises further by the same rule the other way; otherwise neither.
reading.(2) the runs hold: Every run is read by the marks; line heads keep the loop standing if all three line-pr runs hold.
reading.(3) against the earlier runs, as registe: line-pr's whole chains at 20 hops beside r12-stack's (0.920, 0.905, 0.605) and r8-tf's (0.970, none in the corpus's form, 0.910) of practice_cap_raised.json: reported, with the difference of base, code and hardware said.
reading.reported and not read: Every cell, the evaluations along the way, the staircases, the probe after practice, and how any fallen run writes (experiments/forms_families.py).
reading.scope: One family of synthetic lookups, one base a model, three seeds.

what follows: If (1) holds and every line-pr run holds, line heads become the read of the one-model track's stack: the four-family corpus is trained again with them, and practice_several_families.json's questions are asked with that model (and with --dips 1 if practice_that_stands.json passes). If (1) fails while line-pr holds, line heads help recall and reach before practice but practice closes the distance; the next registration asks it at longer lengths than 20 hops. If line-pr runs fall, their rounds are read before anything else.
seen_before_recording: line_heads.json's result, practice_cap_raised.json's results, practice_several_families.json's results, and the registration of practice_that_stands.json. No practice run from line-stack or cell-stack has been made.
